headline: Dhaka ranks 5th among world’s most polluted cities on Friday morning
summary: The capital city faces severe air quality degradation, placing it among the top five most polluted urban centers globally.
details: Dhaka has been ranked as the 5th most polluted city in the world as of Friday morning.
The city's air quality index has reached levels that are considered hazardous to health.
This ranking highlights the ongoing struggle with air pollution in the capital, affecting millions of residents.
Authorities and environmentalists continue to monitor the air quality to identify the primary sources of pollution.

headline: Mongla: Attack on Coast Guard station, members injured
summary: Miscreants attacked a station in the Joymonir Ghol area of the Sundarbans, allegedly to disrupt anti-smuggling operations.
details: A Coast Guard station in the Joymonir Ghol area of Chila Union, Mongla, Bagerhat, was targeted in a sudden attack and vandalism by miscreants on Thursday afternoon.

Several Coast Guard members were reported injured during the incident. The attack took place at a strategically important permanent station established to maintain law and order and combat piracy and smuggling in the Sundarbans coastal region.
According to the Coast Guard, the new station has significantly disrupted the logistics, weapons, and equipment supply chains of pirates and smugglers in the area.
The force claims that criminal gangs, driven by anger over their disrupted operations, planned the attack to force the the Coast Guard to leave the region.
The Coast Guard has taken necessary legal measures to bring the situation under control. A joint operation is currently underway to identify and arrest the suspects involved in the attack.
caption:
Criminal gangs target Coast Guard station in the Sundarbans to protect their smuggling routes.

A Coast Guard station in the Joymonir Ghol area of Chila Union, Mongla, Bagerhat, was targeted in a sudden attack and vandalism by miscreants on Thursday afternoon.

Several Coast Guard members were reported injured during the incident. The attack took place at a strategically important permanent station established to maintain law and order and combat piracy and smuggling in the Sundarbans coastal region.

According to the Coast Guard, the new station has significantly disrupted the logistics, weapons, and equipment supply chains of pirates and smugglers in the area.

The force claims that criminal gangs, driven by anger over their disrupted operations, planned the attack to force the the Coast Guard to leave the region.

The Coast Guard has taken necessary legal measures to bring the situation under control. A joint operation is currently underway to identify and arrest the suspects involved in the attack.

#Bangladesh #Mongla #CoastGuard #Sundarbans #Security

Source: Jamuna TV
